notes.title: One-year Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41214384/1d6bb9c74367924e2a507d43d83ca97d5879810f.png[/img]

Greetings everyone!

My name is Vladimir and I'm the developer of[b] Bright Lights of Svetlov[/b].

It's been a year since the release of the game and this date is of great importance to me. Not only because it's my first commercial project, but thanks to your great reception.

The first week after the release was indeed nervous, a bit scary, but unforgettable! I watched every stream and read every comment - and I still do regularly. I appreciate your reviews, no matter whether it's negative or positive. I do hope the story of the game impressed you in any way.

There is a console port coming within several months, targeting Playstation and Xbox consoles. I can't name the exact date, but it's in production for a while now. 

My next game is in the active development, though it's still a long way before the release or even public announcement. I can tell you only that it's not the direct sequel to the current game, but a brand new project that already looks quite promising. 

See you!
